description_en: The origin of this Śiva temple is uncertain, given the absence of historical records. As the specific name of the temple is unknown, it is simply denoted asśivālaya(lit. the abode of Śiva) for the purpose of this documentation.The temple stands in the Pandhra Śivālaya complex on the eastern bank of the Bagmati river, opposite the cremation grounds. While the complex comprises fifteen similar shrines dedicated to Śiva, all linked to Jaṅga Bahādura Rāṇā, thisśivālaya, too, was probably built by a member of the Rāṇā clan. The temple is not officially part of the Pandhra Śivālaya ensemble despite being within its precincts.Fashioned from bricks, the temple features a dome-style roof adorned with a metallic finial. Latticed windows grace the west, north, and east walls, while the entrance to the sanctum in the south comprises a stone archway (toraṇa) embellished with a central carving of Chepu, a mythical water creature.Within the sanctum, a central stoneśivaliṅgatakes its place as the main deity. No other deities occupy the sanctum, but a Bhairava mask is embedded in the southern outer wall, and a statue of Nandī, the animal mount of Śiva, is positioned to the west of the temple.Despite the temple's uncertain origins, its architectural features suggest a construction date during the Rāṇā period (1846-1951 CE).A Rājopādhyāya priest was appointed to preside over the temple, yet all daily and other rituals at the temple have ceased to be performed (Vīramadhuprakāśevara Temple priest, Ghimire, male, age 55).
description_ne: ऐतिहासिक अभिलेख नपाइएको यस शिवालयमा राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणलाई पुजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको भएपनि नित्यपूजा बन्द भइसकेको छ ।पशुपति क्षेत्रमा रहेको पन्ध्रशिवालय परिसरमा यो शिवालय निर्माण गरिएको छ । गुम्बज शैलीको यो शिवालयमा धातुको गजूर राखिएको छ । इँटा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको यस शिवालयको पश्चिम, उत्तर र पूर्वपट्टिको भित्तामा तिकिझ्या: बनाइएका छन् । यो शिवालयको प्रवेशद्वार दक्षिणपट्टि रहेको छ । प्रवेशद्वारमाथि छेपु अङ्कित ढुङ्गाको तोरण राखिएको छ । शिवालयको गर्भगृहभित्र शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र अन्य कुनै देवता स्थापना गरिएको देखिँदैन । शिवालयको दक्षिणपट्टिको भित्तामा भैरवको मुखाकृति राखिएको छ ।यो शिवालको निर्माणसम्बन्धी कुनै अभिलेख राखिएको पाइँदैन । त्यसैले यसको निर्माता र निर्माणमितिबारे थाहा पाइँदैन । शैलीको आधारमा यो शिवालय राणाकालमा निर्माण गरिएको देखिन्छ ।यस शिवालयमा राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणलाई पुजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको भएपनि नित्यपूजा लगायत अन्य सबै पूजाहरू बन्द भइसकेका छन् (Priest of the Vīramadhuprakāśevara from a Ghimire caste, male, age 55) ।
